security_improvements.finding: Candidate examination workstation shares the subnet with unmonitored local network devices.
security_improvements.action_item: Isolate candidate exam devices onto a dedicated Exam VLAN with strict inter-VLAN firewall routing during testing.

security_improvements.finding: Static MAC identity checks are vulnerable to device impersonation via MAC address spoofing (Phase 3 audit).
security_improvements.action_item: Enforce 802.1X Port-Based Network Access Control (NAC) alongside candidate hardware MAC verification.
